description: This file implements the RtXcastConnector class, which manages remote communication and event handling for application launch, stop, hide, state, resume, and service disconnection events via remote procedure calls and callbacks in a C++ environment.

classes.name: RtXcastConnector
classes.description: Manages remote event callbacks and connection lifecycle for casting services.

methods.name: processRtMessages
methods.description: Processes incoming remote messages in an event loop.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Thread function to run message processing.

methods.name: onRtServiceByeCallback
methods.description: Callback for remote service exit events.

methods.name: connectToRemoteService
methods.description: Establishes connection to remote casting service.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes remote environment and starts event thread.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down remote environment and event thread.
